text:
maria: Heads up — seeing a perf regression on Llama2-13B after the recent default change to rope_theta and the RMSNorm->SiLU fused-kernel bump. P99 token latency ~18% higher on long-context (4k) tails. Repro steps + traces below. @aj @samir :eyes:

aj: Can you paste the exact config you used? Which kernel selector flags did the rollout flip?

maria: Config snippet: `models/llama2/13b/runtime.yaml` changed `rope_theta: auto` -> `rope_theta: scaled_v2` and enabled `rmsnorm_silu_fuse: true` in selector. Command I ran:

```
# reproduce locally (cuda-rt)
./run_infer --model llama2-13b --seq-len 4096 --batch 1 --profile /tmp/trace.pb
```

Profile excerpt (top kernels):
```
kernel_select: fallback=generic_gemm (45%)
matmul_fused: 12%
rmsnorm_silu_fused: 3%
kv_cache_hotpath: 18%
other: 22%
```

maria: Note the selector is choosing generic_gemm for a bunch of SiLU-adjacent ops which ends up increasing memory traffic and killing the latency bucket. Also seeing more KV cache churn on hosts with uneven headstride (head_dim % 64 != 0).

samir: I saw something similar on dedicated nodes yesterday — headstride mismatch causes our prefetch heuristics to misalign page boundaries and we get micro-evictions. Short graph I recorded: memory-bandwidth spikes right before p99 jumps. Quick ascii chart:

```
time -> |----| spikes ^ |------| p99
mem   -> |====|====|====|===|    
```

natalie: Could be compounding: fused kernel not picked + prefetch misaligned -> more memcpy. Two mitigations to try: 1) tighten kernel selector threshold so fused RMSNorm-SiLU is preferred when hidden_size divisible by 128 or head_dim >= 64; 2) make prefetch aligner aware of headstride to avoid crossing page boundaries.

jon: I drafted a small selector patch — prefer_fused when `(hidden_size % 128 == 0 || head_dim >= 64)` and fall back only if smem pressure would exceed 1.2x. Diff (very small):

```
- if (score_fused > score_generic) select = fused;
+ if ((hidden_size % 128 == 0 || head_dim >= 64) && score_fused > score_generic * 0.85) select = fused;
```

jon: Also added a guard to avoid fused selection when `kv_stride % 4096 != 0` (this was the page-cross condition).

maria: Ran jon's patch on a canary host (prod-dedicated-3), microbench results: p99 down ~9% (from +18% to +9% over baseline) and KV eviction rate halved. Raw numbers:

```
baseline p99: 48ms
after default change: 57ms (+18%)
after selector patch: 52ms (+8%)
kv-evict-rate: 0.12 -> 0.06
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: canary=prod-dedicated-3, image=runtime-2026-03-18-rc4, selector_patch=on. If metrics stable for 30m will roll to pool-1 :rocket:

perf-bot: Automated check: 30m window -> p99 trend decreasing, CPU spill reduced, :chart_with_upwards_trend: overall improvement flagged.

aj: Nice. Two followups: (1) add a unit test that verifies selection for edge head_dim/hidden_size combos; (2) tie the prefetch aligner change to a runtime flag so we can toggle for specific hosts.

maria: Agreed. I'll file a tiny PR for the test + runtime flag. Also adding a small replay test with 4k chat templates — saw chat prompts expose the regression worse because prefix KV growth + system messages increase initial kv_stride.

samir: FYI, when you enable the runtime flag, set default=false for older hw families (A100-20GB) to avoid regressions. For V100s we should enable immediately.

maria: Will do. Thanks all — keeping this thread for rollout notes. If anyone sees residual p99 spikes ping here. :thumbsup:
